noAccess.title: You cannot open Scrap & rework
noAccess.body: This needs the permission {permission}. Ask an administrator to give it to your role.

page.detailKeys: in a row’s detail: approve, refuse, previous and next row

pareto.title: By reason
pareto.filter: Filter the list by a bar
pareto.otherHeld: The smaller groups together: pick one in the list instead.
pareto.none: Nothing scrapped or reworked in these rows.
pareto.hint: Pieces of the rows shown (the period and filters above), largest first; a bar filters the list.

list.search: Search work order, bundle, reason or lot
list.failed: Scrap and rework could not be read

noMatch.title: No rows match these filters
noMatch.body: Clear the filters to see every row of the period.

empty.title: No scrap yet
empty.body: Scrap and rework reported at the operations, and every rework order, appear here.

list.hint: {period}: the latest 500 rows; filters and the pareto work on them. Per work order, bundle, operation and station, never per person.

held.reason: Say why in at least 3 characters.
held.noReduction: Nothing waits for a decision on this row.
held.ownAsk: You asked for it: another person approves or refuses it.

approve.none: Select rows with a lower quantity to approve.
approve.nothing: None of the rows selected has a lower quantity you may approve.

item.valueHint: at the cost of the hides’ issue
item.leatherNone: No hide named: the bundle’s cut is not linked to a hide.
item.leatherRework: A rework brings the garments back; its scrap shows on its own row.
item.leatherHint: The leather left stock when it was issued to the work order; this is what these garments held.
item.refuseHint: The person who asked reads it.
item.noPhoto: The floor’s scrap reports carry no photo yet.

replace.title: Replace scrapped quantity
replace.body: {left} of {pieces} garments of {cell} still need a replacement.

kind.RECUTHint: A recut need on the cut ({part}); the cutting table cuts it as single parts.
kind.REDUCEHint: Another person approves it; the order line is then closed short.

held.rework: A rework brings the garments back: replace what its scrap lost, on the scrap row.
held.notOpen: Work order {number} is {status}: only a released or running work order is replaced.
held.covered: Every garment of this row is replaced already.

notice.refused: The lower quantity is refused; the person who asked reads why.

asked.RECUT_one: A recut of {count} garment is asked for {number}: it is on the cutting room’s list.
asked.RECUT_other: A recut of {count} garments is asked for {number}: it is on the cutting room’s list.
asked.REDUCE_one: A lower quantity of {count} garment is asked for {number}: another person approves it.
asked.REDUCE_other: A lower quantity of {count} garments is asked for {number}: another person approves it.

problem.offline: The factory server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
problem.write: This was not saved. Try again.
problem.changed: Someone changed this meanwhile. It was read again: check and try again.
problem.invalid: The request was refused as it is. Check the fields.
problem.notOpen: The work order is not open: only a released or running one is replaced.
problem.moreThanScrapped: More than was scrapped: earlier replacements already cover part of it.
problem.moreThanCell: More garments than the size holds.
problem.noScrap: Nothing was scrapped there to replace.
problem.notAPart: That part is not a part of this garment.
problem.selfDecision: You asked for it: another person decides it.
problem.wrongState: It was decided meanwhile. The rows were read again.
